clone.description: A conversation layer above an evidence-aware core.
clone.emptyNote: Try the fictional learning question, or ask about a life event without a record.
clone.placeholder: Ask the demo clone a question…
clone.replyKnown: In this fictional demo, I learn by making a small prototype, then reflecting on what did not work.
clone.replyMissing: No reliable memory found. I do not have evidence to answer that question about you.
clone.whyKnown: Matched an explicit synthetic opinion about learning. The highlighted path is a visual demo, not live retrieval.
clone.whyMissing: No supported demo topic matched. Missing evidence is preserved instead of inventing a memory.
clone.memoryQuote: I learn best by building a small prototype and reflecting on what did not work.
privacy.demo: Fictional demo only. No real persona, LLM, or private archive is connected.
privacy.input: Your answers stay in page memory and clear on refresh. Use fictional examples for presentations.
privacy.export: Exports contain your entered text. Store them privately; they are not written to the Master Archive.
privacy.counts: Real archive counts remain 0. Demo structure is not a verified persona.

question.0: Think of a small project you enjoyed. What made it meaningful to you?
question.1: Why did that matter? What did you choose to prioritize?
question.2: What trade-off did you make, and what would you change next time?
question.3: What evidence could make you reconsider that decision?
question.4: How has your perspective changed over time?
sample.0: I enjoyed building a fictional garden planner. Making something useful mattered to me.
sample.1: I prioritized learning through a small working prototype.
sample.2: I chose a simple design over extra features so I could test it sooner.
sample.3: Feedback from someone using it would help me reconsider.
sample.4: I now ask for feedback earlier. This is a fictional demonstration.
